package.description: VistaSwitcher makes it easier for you to locate windows and switch focus, even on multi-monitor systems. The switcher window consists of an easy-to-read list of all tasks running with clearly shown titles and a full-sized preview of the selected task.

en-US.description: VistaSwitcher makes it easier for you to locate windows and switch focus, even on multi-monitor systems. The switcher window consists of an easy-to-read list of all tasks running with clearly shown titles and a full-sized preview of the selected task.
en-US.longDescription: VistaSwitcher makes it easier for you to locate windows and switch focus, even on multi-monitor systems. The switcher window consists of an easy-to-read list of all tasks running with clearly shown titles and a full-sized preview of the selected task. NOTE: VistaSwitcher runs only on Windows XP/Vista/7. The last version of VistaSwitcher 1.1.5 was released on May 12, 2012. There are no plans to update it, please use Alt-Tab Terminator on newer OS.
en-US.name: VistaSwitcher
